title: Check several conditions with otherwise if
objective: Chain conditions with otherwise if, and understand that only the first true condition runs.

body.text: When you have more than two outcomes, add otherwise if branches after the first if. Lagom checks them from top to bottom. The first condition that is true runs its lines, and the rest are skipped, even if they are also true.

body.title: Grade a score
body.code:
make score equal to 85
if score is at least 90
    say "A"
otherwise if score is at least 80
    say "B"
make temperature equal to 22
if temperature is greater than 30
    say "hot"
otherwise if temperature is greater than 15
    say "mild"

body.text: Order matters. Put the most specific condition first. In the example below, the second branch would also be true for 5, but the first branch wins because it is checked first.

body.title: The first true branch wins
body.code:
make age equal to 4
if age is less than 5
    say "toddler"
otherwise if age is less than 13
    say "child"
make status equal to "open"
if status is equal to "new"
    say "created"
otherwise if status is equal to "open"
    say "already open"

body.prompt: A score of 85 should earn a B, but the program prints C. Make it print B.
body.starter:
make score equal to 85
if score is at least 90
    say "A"
otherwise
    say "C"
body.solution:
make score equal to 85
if score is at least 90
    say "A"
otherwise if score is at least 80
    say "B"
otherwise
    say "C"

checks.description: It has an otherwise if branch
